title: Sign-in return: say when this browser could not store the sign-in
evidence: A sign-in whose exchange this browser refuses to store with no log-off (a full device store; setSignIns false in widget-src/src/storage/dropbox.ts and drive.ts completeRedirect) opens as a guest with no line, and resolveBackend (widget-src/standalone/resolve-backend.ts) shows none when rememberSignIn refuses after a saved exchange. Both are US-09 AC60 limits; a line would need its own words.
